name: EEG Foundation Challenge
description: The challenge involves developing models for zero-shot decoding of EEG data across new tasks and subjects, as well as predicting latent psychological constructs (e.g., p-factor) from EEG recordings.

cr:input.name: HBN-EEG Dataset
cr:input.description: High-density EEG recordings (128 channels) from over 3,000 participants aged 5-21 years, engaging in six distinct cognitive tasks (Resting State, Surround Suppression, Movie Watching, Contrast Change Detection, Sequence Learning, Symbol Search). Includes demographic attributes (age, gender, handedness) and psychopathology factors (internalization, externalization, attention, p-factor). Data is formatted in BIDS standard with event annotations using HED.
